messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] i am not able to deploy shiny app.
parts:
I am guessing that somewhere in your application you are referring to the data file that you are loading with an absolute path instead of a relative path.  
Example:

read.csv("C:\yourappdirectory\yourfilename") 
Instead of 
read.csv("yourfilename")
